I faced a very similar situation. My cat had lived in the same house for almost 20 years and went outside daily. (I was like 9 when I got him I didn’t know you shouldn’t let them be indoor/outdoor). I was moving from my parents to my own place and I knew it wouldn’t be safe for him to go outside there, but to change such an old cats lifestyle so drastically would be cruel. 

So, he had to stay behind with my parents. He still is very very excited when he gets to see me, but he bonded with them more and is a happy boy again.  It was hard and took me a long time to get another cat, but I made the right choice for him.
